Name: Earthy Recolour Waterfall Fix For SVE and Grandpa's Farm
Author: Niteslash
Description:
[b]Fixes the waterfalls on [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] [b]& the optional but highly recommended Grandpa's Farm to match those from [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url][b] mod.[/b]

[b]Changelog:
[/b]
[b]1.3     -     [/b]Rebuilt the mod to work with SVE's new waterfalls. Note, however, this will, at present, revert them to the previous texture style.
[b]1.2.1  -    [/b]Fixed a few pixels poking through summer waterfall. Matched the steps and footbridge in Grandpa's grove to Daisy's palette.
[b]1.2     -    [/b]Outdoor hotsprings will now match the colour of other water to make Grandpa's grove not incredibly jarring.
[b]1.1     -    [/b]The water tiles now all match much more closely with the rest of the recolour.
[b]1.0.1  -[/b][b]    [/b]Changed depencies to not absolutely require Grandpa's Farm so that any farm using SVE's tilesheets will benefit from this mod.
[b]1.0     -    [/b]Initial release.

[b]Installation:[/b]

Unzip the folder into your [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[/b] folder
